outerRepository.note: Independent outer repository; existing untracked recovery, release, art, documentation and nested worktree directories were retained.

rainAudio.note: Existing V1 rain file and generator are retained for recoverability. There is no rain audio element, loading reference, control, handler, or playback state in active source; the generator was not run.

storage.note: V1 used no saved audio preferences. Only abl-theme is read or written; no removed rain preference is consulted or can reactivate audio.
